chronology_assertion: Reviewer-recorded operational order: delivery_manifest_closed_at <= metadata_audit_completed_at <= data_review_attestation_completed_at <= coverage_report_completed_at <= reviewer.recorded_at. These timestamps are not a cryptographic proof of order.
completion_rule: The reviewer sets status to completed; checks the immutable closed delivery manifest and exact hashes of the later metadata audit, data-review attestation, and coverage report; verifies exact canonical amount_unit=CNY plus the provider-unit normalization evidence hash; verifies every quote row carries the fixed price-adjustment tokens and satisfies close=close_raw*adjustment_factor within the registered tolerance, with valid hashes for the provider close_raw definition, factor convention, and normalization/adapter evidence; records the reviewer-verified operational chronology without claiming that its timestamps are cryptographically established; records exactly one allowed decision; and signs or cites an institutionally auditable approval. OPERATIONAL_CHECKLIST_COMPLETE requires canonical_amount_unit_verified=true, price_adjustment_contract_verified=true, all four normalization/definition evidence hashes valid, every checklist item in provider_delivery_acceptance_protocol.md to pass, and an empty blocking_reason_codes list. BLOCKED requires at least one non-identifying reason code. This optional private custody record is non-authoritative, is created after and never written into the closed delivery manifest, and is not a design-manifest input, formal data acceptance, external registration, or execution authorization; authorization_granted must remain false.
